subject: eng
title: Grammar 2A Ch 6: Jobs, Simple Present, Possessives & And/Or

questions.q: Gigi's father is a fireman. He ___ out fires.
questions.explain: 第三人稱單數 He 描述職業工作（事實）用簡單現在式 puts out fires。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Gigi's father is a fireman. He ___ out fires.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2A Ch 6: Jobs, Simple Present, Possessives & And/Or

questions.q: Wendy is a policewoman. She ___ bad people.
questions.explain: catch 以 ch 結尾，第三人稱單數 She 後面要加 -es（catches）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Wendy is a policewoman. She ___ bad people.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2A Ch 6: Jobs, Simple Present, Possessives & And/Or

questions.q: What is your ___ job? She is a nurse. She looks after sick people.
questions.explain: 表示「媽媽的職業」要用所有格名詞 mother's（加 's）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: What is your ___ job? She is a nurse. She looks after sick people.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2A Ch 6: Jobs, Simple Present, Possessives & And/Or

questions.q: Do you have any brothers ___ sisters?
questions.explain: 在疑問句（Do you have any ...?）中連接兩個並列名詞時用 or。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Do you have any brothers ___ sisters?
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2A Ch 6: Jobs, Simple Present, Possessives & And/Or

questions.q: No, I have no brothers ___ sisters. I am an only child.
questions.explain: 在否定句（have no ...）中連接兩個並列項目時用 or。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: No, I have no brothers ___ sisters. I am an only child.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2A Ch 6: Jobs, Simple Present, Possessives & And/Or

questions.q: Yes, I have one brother ___ two sisters.
questions.explain: 在肯定句中連接兩個並列名詞時用 and。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Yes, I have one brother ___ two sisters.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2A Ch 6: Jobs, Simple Present, Possessives & And/Or

questions.q: Fill in the correct verb form: Alan is a postman. He ___ (bring) letters to people.
questions.explain: 主語 He 是第三人稱單數，bring 加 -s 變成 brings。
